snippet.title: WANDERSKY - PINNED VIDEO ON SOCIAL MEDIA
snippet.description:
Wandersky is a top-down adventure following the story of Kuu and Tama through the skies of Hyndara☁️

One arrow for combat & puzzles🏹 
Genbu, your flying house 🌳 🏠 
Handcrafted maps full of mysteries🗺️
Metroidvania-style progression 🆙

Wishlist now. The sky is always there for those who wander 🌥️... 

Follow the developement journey in our socials ⤵️!
